_comment: Kalshi series to watch. A series ticker is the prefix before the first dash in a market ticker. Find them with: node kalshi-watcher.js --discover <keyword>
_thresholds_comment: Top-level `thresholds` are the defaults. Any series can override any of them with its own `thresholds` block. Sports and macro cannot share one setting: a 10c move is news on a Fed contract and just the third quarter happening on an NFL moneyline.
_pinned_comment: Specific market tickers always watched, regardless of volume.
_alerts_comment: Delivery channels. kalshi-alerts.tsv is always written regardless — muting changes where a signal goes, never whether it is recorded. Set email back to true to resume Kalshi email. Does not affect the TradingView flip notifier, which has its own email path.
